en: A black and white photograph featuring a snowy street scene with two men in overcoats and hats standing beside a snowbank. Behind them, a multi-story wooden building under construction is visible, with scaffolding along its facade. Several other figures can be seen in the background. On the right, a vintage car, likely from the 1940s, is partially visible. There are evergreen trees in the background and a lot of snow accumulations, indicating a cold, northern climate. Text is visible on a shop sign on the left side.
